scripts.dev: bun run sync && cd web && bunx vite
scripts.typecheck: cd worker && bunx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && bunx tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json --noEmit && cd ../web && bunx tsc --noEmit
scripts.build: bun run sync && bun run typecheck && cd web && bunx vite build
scripts.preview: bun run sync && cd web && bunx vite preview
scripts.deploy: bun run deploy:api && bun run deploy:web
scripts.deploy:web: bun run build && cd web && bunx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name sinluz --branch main --commit-dirty=true
